snippet.title: Dungeoneers Idle - Free Demo Out Now | Automated Dungeon Crawler RPG
snippet.description:
Solo-developed idle RPG. Your party of four heroes explores the dungeons on their own, you handle the gear, growth, and strategy behind them.

The free demo is out now. No time limit, and your save carries over to the full game.
Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5135740/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=demo_launch

Dungeoneers Idle is a fully automated idle RPG, built solo. Send four hero classes into procedurally generated dungeons, watch them fight, loot, and level up on their own, and spend your time on what actually matters: gearing them up, unlocking new classes, and pushing your prestige loop further with every run.

What you'll be doing:
- Recruiting and building a party of four distinct hero classes
- Exploring procedurally generated dungeons that auto-battle in real time
- Collecting and equipping loot that actually matters
- Prestiging to grow stronger and push deeper than the run before
- Unlocking a full meta-progression tree between runs

If you like it, a wishlist helps a lot: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5135740/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=demo_launch
